Subject: Incubator partnership — pricing & credit flexibility

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — GreenBridge runs a cohort of ~35 early-stage teams and we're evaluating partners for our platform credits. A few questions came up from the program leads:

- Do you have a standard incubator/accelerator credit allocation?
- Are there any one-off promotional exceptions (larger credits, multi-quarter discounts) you can make for an incubator partner where all our cohorts get onboarding credits?
- For startups that graduate and convert to paid, are there milestone-based top-ups or referral discounts?

I've attached a draft Incubator MOU (greenbridge-incubator-agreement.pdf) — looking for an initial sense of flexibility so we can build a recommendation to our steering committee next Monday.

Appreciate any examples/benchmarks you can share.

Best,
Leah Park
Program Director — GreenBridge Incubator
leah@greenbridge.ai

Hi Leah — thanks for the MOU and context. Looping in Marissa (partnerships) and Monica (finance) to scope what we can do. Quick answers up front so you have something for the steering committee:

- Standard: we offer a baseline of $5k in platform credits per cohort startup (3 months), plus a 30% discounted reserved plan for teams that commit to Dedicated within 90 days.
- Exceptions: we can approve larger, cohort-level credit pools for strategic incubators, but that typically requires an internal credit exception and a signed MOA.
- Graduates: we can structure milestone referrals (e.g., $1k top-up on first paid invoice + a 10% referral credit applied to the incubator account).

Marissa / Monica — can you confirm what level of cohort-wide credit we can approve without exec sign-off? Leah — I'll follow up with a proposed one-off exception and sample language for the MOU.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Subject: RE: Incubator partnership — pricing & credit flexibility

Karthik / Monica — based on similar partner programs, here's a suggested path we can approve at the partnership team level (no VP sign-off):

- Cohort pilot (one quarter): allocate a shared credit pool of $50k per cohort (covers ~10 teams at baseline $5k each but gives flexibility to reallocate).
- Marketing exchange: in exchange for co-branded materials and a joint webinar, Redwood gets a 12-month referral window for cohorts that graduate.
- Per-startup cap: no single startup should receive > $10k in credits from the incubator pool without additional approval.

I've attached a pricing-exception-form.xlsx with fields for program name, cohort dates, expected conversion %, and proposed credit pool. Fill that and I can sign-off.

If Finance wants to tighten any constraints, Monica please flag.

—Marissa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Incubator partnership — pricing & credit flexibility

Marissa / Karthik — finance perspective: the partnership-level $50k pilot is acceptable under these conditions:

- Discount floor: any per-startup effective discount cannot exceed 65% off list pricing unless approved by Sales Ops director.
- Accounting: the cohort pool must be prepaid or committed in a 3-month invoice so we can amortize credits for revenue recognition.
- Risk cap: limit total cohort exposure to $75k until we observe >=10% paid conversion within 90 days post-cohort.

If GreenBridge is willing to sign a 3-month prepaid MOA for the pilot, we can proceed without exec escalation.

Monica
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Hi Leah — thanks for waiting while we scoped internally. Based on the MOU you sent and the pilot ask, here's a concise proposal we can sign today: 

1) Pilot credit pool: $50,000 prepaid account credit tied to Cohort Q3-2026 (redeemable across cohort teams).
2) Per-team cap: $10,000 max from the pool; we recommend baseline allocation of $4k per startup to encourage early usage.
3) Marketing exchange: joint webinar + 3 co-branded case studies in 12 months.
4) Graduation conversion: for any startup that converts to paid within 90 days, Redwood provides a $1,000 one-time top-up and GreenBridge receives a 10% referral credit to the incubator account.

Conditions from Finance: discount floor (no >65% off list per team), and the $50k must be prepaid and amortized. I've attached a one-page exception summary and updated MOU language (see attachments). If that looks good, I'll send a DocuSign with the prepaid invoice link.
